doc.text: A slot that is meant to be used together with <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/inventory/BaseItemStackHandler">BaseItemStackHandler</ref>. The slot will use the handler for item operations, but <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/menu/slot/BaseSlot" method="mayPlace" type="(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack)boolean">#mayPlace(ItemStack)</ref> only checks the item validators without the output slot restriction, and <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/menu/slot/BaseSlot" method="mayPickup" type="(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player)boolean">#mayPickup(Player)</ref> always allows pickup from non-empty slots.
